# graviteeam_domain_flow (Resource)

Manages authentication flows for a Gravitee AM domain. Flows exist by default; this resource configures them via GET/PUT.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "graviteeam_domain_flow" "example" {
  domain_id = graviteeam_domain.example.id
  flows     = jsonencode([])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (String) The ID of the domain
- `flows` (String) JSON string containing the domain flow definitions. PUT replaces the entire flow list.
